rows.grounds: gerund of nidhā; action completed before worship
dative purpose: peace from stone-fall and similar calamities

items.question: What ritual action in the house secures peace from stone-fall and similar calamities?
items.inference: domestic worship after placement pacifies stone-fall calamities
items.plain_english: Having placed it, one should worship in the house for peace from stone-fall and similar calamities.
